title: National Book Award for Nonfiction Goes to Writer Denied Visa to Attend
summary: The author Abdelrahman ElGendy received one of the major American prizes for nonfiction in absentia for his memoir, “Huna.” Hannah Lillith Assadi won the fiction prize.
